lines: Routine follow-up for rising serum creatinine

This 45-year-old male with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease returns for routine nephrology follow-up four months after deceased donor kidney transplantation, following cytomegalovirus colitis one month ago.

Four months after receiving a kidney transplant due to end-stage renal disease secondary to hypertension, he has no complaints and has been adherent to his immunosuppressive regimen, which includes tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, and prednisone.
